hook: Vahdat leads engineering strategy for Google's AI infrastructure as Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, a role created in December 2025 after fifteen years at the company building its Tensor Processing Unit chips, data center networking, and compute systems. He previously served as Vice President and General Manager of Machine Learning, Systems and Cloud AI.
name: Amin Vahdat

quote.text: Ironwood is our most powerful, capable and energy efficient TPU yet, designed to power thinking, inferential AI models at scale.

moniker: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure at Google

quick_facts: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure at Google, a newly created role announced in December 2025
Previously Vice President and General Manager of Machine Learning, Systems and Cloud AI at Google, overseeing its Tensor Processing Unit chip program
Joined Google in 2010 after holding the SAIC endowed chair in computer science and engineering at UC San Diego
Named a Google Fellow in 2015 and inducted into the National Academy of Engineering in 2023
Earned a PhD in computer science from UC Berkeley in 1998

achievements.title: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, Google
achievements.impact: Leads engineering strategy across custom silicon, data centers, networking, and supply chain for Google's AI infrastructure, in a role created in December 2025 that reports to CEO Sundar Pichai.

achievements.title: Vice President and General Manager, Machine Learning, Systems and Cloud AI, Google
achievements.impact: Directed engineering for Google's Tensor Processing Unit chip line, including the seventh generation Ironwood TPU announced in April 2025, and its Jupiter data center network.

achievements.title: Professor and SAIC Chair, University of California San Diego
achievements.impact: Led research on data center and wide area networking before joining Google in 2010.
